name: Davao River Bridge
facts: The Davao River Bridge, spanning 140 meters, was widened from two to six lanes between 2015 and 2018, a project completed by Vicente T. Lao Construction upstream and a joint venture downstream.
On April 18, 2018, the fully renovated bridge opened, and Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte officially inaugurated it on May 24, 2018, marking a milestone for Davao City traffic.

Renovation costs reached ₱345 million, adding reinforced abutments, reflectorized thermoplastic markings, sidewalks, a craneway steel component, and an asphalt overlay to boost daily capacity to 31,576 motorists.
